# Fast Orbit

> Fast Orbit is a TanStack Start SSG starter on Cloudflare Pages — file-based routing, cached server state, charts, tables and virtualized lists. Type-safe with Zod, Base UI and Tailwind. Clone and ship.

Built with React 19, Vite, TanStack Router/Start/Query/Table/Virtual/Charts/Hotkeys. Source at [github.com/Double77x/fastorbit-vite](https://github.com/Double77x/fastorbit-vite). Fast Orbit is SSG — every route prerenders to static HTML.

For agents working on the Fast Orbit codebase, read the guidance files below before making changes — they encode the project's strict logic, performance, accessibility and styling conventions.

## Documentation

- [CODING_STANDARDS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/fastorbit-vite/main/docs/CODING_STANDARDS.md): Strict logic, performance, accessibility and linting rules. Read first.
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/fastorbit-vite/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): High-level system design and data flow.
- [STYLE_GUIDE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/fastorbit-vite/main/docs/STYLE_GUIDE.md): Visual tokens, themes and animation patterns.
- [TECH_STACK.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/fastorbit-vite/main/docs/TECH_STACK.md): Complete list of libraries and versions.
- [ROADMAP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Double77x/fastorbit-vite/main/docs/ROADMAP.md): Planned features and direction.

## Tools

- [Live Weather Demo](https://fastorbit.danread.gq/#weather): TanStack Query + Charts + Table + Virtual with Open-Meteo.
- [Quick Start](https://fastorbit.danread.gq/#quick-start): Clone, install and ship in 30 seconds.
